notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871669/0b7f257e4a57a3f960ff349f0b54eb900124e575.png[/img]

[b]Exciting News for Space Expedition Explorers!
[/b]

We're thrilled to announce a major update to Space Expedition that enhances your interstellar journey! Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Controller Support[/b]: Dive into the adventure with seamless controller integration, now fully supporting both Xbox and PlayStation controllers.
[*] [b]Optimized for Steam Deck:[/b] Experience Space Expedition like never before on Steam Deck, with optimizations that make it the perfect match for your handheld gaming.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b] We've squashed numerous bugs and corrected localization errors to ensure a smoother expedition.
[*] [b]Revamped User Interface:[/b] Navigate through the stars with ease thanks to our completely redesigned UI, crafted for an intuitive and immersive experience.
[*] [b]Progress Reset Option[/b]: Looking to start anew or test your skills from scratch? You can now clear your progress via an option in the settings menu.
[*] [b]Mac Compatibility:[/b] Mac users, it's time to celebrate! Space Expedition is now available on macOS, opening the door to even more explorers.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.33
notes.content:
Game Update Changelog:

[list]
[*] [b]Controls optimization[/b]: The game's controls have been improved to enhance the overall gameplay experience. Players should notice smoother and more responsive controls.

[*] [b]Fixed bugs in localization[/b]: Issues related to localization have been resolved. This means that any language-specific bugs or errors that players may have encountered have been fixed.

[*] [b]Fixed achievement "Near-Immortal"[/b]: The achievement "Near-Immortal" has been fixed. Players should now be able to unlock it successfully without any issues.

[*] [b]In-game sounds refactoring[/b]: The game's sounds have undergone a refactoring process. This involved adjusting and normalizing the volume of in-game sounds to create a more balanced and immersive audio experience for players.
[/list]
